meta.ratingSource: Podnews.net aggregate (Rephonic: Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Podchaser, Podcast Addict)
meta.notes: Items with verified:false have metadata from list articles or editorial knowledge; the weekly refresh job confirms links, artwork, frequency, launch date and ratings.

items.name: CyberWire Daily
items.desc: Weekday briefing of around 20–30 minutes covering breaches, policy, vulnerabilities and research, with expert interviews and recurring segments such as Research Saturday.

items.name: Risky Business
items.desc: Long-running weekly news analysis and interviews, known for sharp judgement and minimal hype. Includes Soap Box and Snake Oilers spin-off segments.

items.name: SANS Internet Stormcenter StormCast
items.desc: A five-to-ten-minute daily briefing on new vulnerabilities, active exploitation and attack trends seen by the SANS Internet Storm Center.

items.name: Cyber Security Headlines
items.desc: Bite-size weekday news bulletin under ten minutes, with a Friday weekly review that puts the week's stories in context.

items.name: Smashing Security
items.desc: Entertaining weekly round-up of security stories, scams and tech blunders, delivered with British wit. Multiple-time Best Security Podcast winner at the European Security Blogger Awards.

items.name: ShadowTalk
items.desc: Weekly threat intelligence discussion from ReliaQuest's research team covering active campaigns, threat actors and practical defensive takeaways.

items.name: Defensive Security Podcast
items.desc: Practitioner-led look at recent breaches and what defenders should learn from them. Releases have become less frequent, but the archive is rich for SOC and IR teams.

items.name: Blueprint Podcast (SANS)
items.desc: Hands-on blue-team show about building and running SOCs: detection engineering, log analysis, tooling and analyst workflow.

items.name: Beers with Talos
items.desc: Relaxed conversations with Cisco Talos researchers about threat research, malware campaigns and life in an intelligence team.

items.name: Talos Takes
items.desc: Five-to-ten-minute weekly explainers on a single security topic, emerging threat or attacker trend from the Talos team.

items.name: Unsupervised Learning
items.desc: Weekly synthesis of security, AI and technology trends with commentary on what they mean for practitioners and society.

items.name: Future of Threat Intelligence
items.desc: Interviews with CTI leaders on building intelligence programmes, threat hunting and turning intelligence into action.

items.name: DISCARDED: Tales from the Threat Research Trenches
items.desc: Proofpoint threat researchers discuss real campaigns, actor tradecraft and the craft of threat research.

items.name: The Defender's Advantage
items.desc: Mandiant experts on incident response, threat intelligence and frontline findings from investigations.

items.name: AI Security Podcast
items.desc: Two former CISOs on securing AI systems and using AI in security: prompt injection, agent risks, build-vs-buy and real implementations.

items.name: Cloud Security Podcast
items.desc: Vendor-neutral interviews on securing AWS, Azure, GCP and Kubernetes, from identity and posture to cloud detection and response.

items.name: Cloud Security Podcast by Google
items.desc: Google Cloud's security team on cloud-native defence, detection, SecOps and AI, with internal and external guests.

items.name: Hacked
items.desc: Alternates long-form story episodes about strange corners of tech crime with lighter monthly news chats.

items.name: Cyber Bytes
items.desc: Conversations with UK cyber leaders and practitioners on careers, hiring and the people side of the industry.

items.name: Hacker Valley Studio
items.desc: People-first stories from across security: career journeys, burnout, imposter syndrome and leadership growth.

items.name: 5bytes Podcast
items.desc: Short episodes covering end-user computing, Microsoft tech and security news in five quick bytes.

items.name: The World of Intelligence
items.desc: Defence and open-source intelligence analysts discuss geopolitics, OSINT tradecraft and the intelligence cycle.

items.name: Darknet Diaries
items.desc: Investigative, highly produced true stories of hacks, cybercrime and espionage, often told by the people involved. A great gateway into the field.

items.name: Hacking Humans
items.by: Dave Bittner, Joe Carrigan & Maria Varmazis · N2K
items.desc: Social engineering, phishing and scam stories broken down with practical prevention lessons. Ideal for awareness teams.

items.name: Hacker and the Fed
items.desc: A former FBI agent and the hacker he once arrested discuss cybercrime cases, news and the ethics of law enforcement.

items.name: Troy Hunt's Weekly Update
items.desc: Weekly video/audio update from the creator of Have I Been Pwned on data breaches, web security and running a breach-notification service.

items.name: Cyber Hack
items.desc: BBC investigative series telling the stories behind major cyber attacks and the people who carried them out.

items.name: Security Now
items.desc: Two-hour weekly deep dive into vulnerabilities, crypto and protocols. One of the oldest security podcasts, with full transcripts and show notes.

items.name: Cybersecurity Simplified
items.by: David Barton & Susanna Song · Highwire Networks
items.desc: Under-30-minute episodes making online safety and security news understandable for non-specialists.

items.name: No Such Podcast
items.desc: Six-episode limited series from the NSA revealing declassified stories of signals intelligence and cyber missions.

items.name: Shielded: The Last Line of Cyber Defense
items.desc: Post-quantum cryptography migration in practice: standards, hardware readiness, crypto agility and real migration stories.

items.name: The Privacy, Security & OSINT Show
items.desc: Methodical, practical guidance on personal privacy, OPSEC and open-source intelligence from a former FBI investigator. Slower release schedule but a dense archive.

items.name: Host Unknown
items.by: Javvad Malik, Thom Langford & Andy Agnês
items.desc: Irreverent infosec news and opinion from industry veterans — a pub chat with decades of experience behind it.

items.name: Defense in Depth
items.desc: One contested security question per episode, worked through with CISOs and community input in about 25 minutes.

items.name: CISO Series Podcast
items.desc: Candid peer discussion on how security leaders communicate risk, manage vendors and make hard calls.

items.name: Capture the CISO
items.desc: Vendors pitch to a panel of CISOs — a rare view of how security buyers evaluate tools.

items.name: Malicious Life
items.desc: Finished archive of 260+ narrated histories of cyber attacks and the people behind them, from early viruses to Stuxnet.

items.name: Cybersecurity Today
items.desc: Short news updates several times a week on breaches, patches and regulation for busy practitioners.

items.name: The Social-Engineer Podcast
items.desc: Influence, persuasion and human hacking with psychologists, investigators and red-teamers.

items.name: 401 Access Denied
items.desc: Conversational show spanning red teaming, identity, zero trust and insider threat with frontline guests.

items.name: Human Factor Security
items.desc: The 'People Hacker' interviews hackers, psychologists and criminologists about manipulation, scams and human-centric security.

items.name: The Cyber Queens Podcast
items.desc: Career paths, leadership and community advocacy from women working across cybersecurity.

items.name: 7 Minute Security
items.desc: Short, tactical episodes on pentesting, vulnerability management and practical defence for busy practitioners.

items.name: Getting Into Infosec
items.desc: Candid interviews about how people broke into security and what they wish they had known.

items.name: Redefining CyberSecurity
items.desc: Big-picture view of security in business and society: ethics, resilience, policy and leadership.

items.name: mnemonic Security Podcast
items.desc: Calm, European-perspective conversations on threat intelligence, detection engineering, incident response and architecture.

items.name: Security. Cryptography. Whatever.
items.by: Deirdre Connolly, Thomas Ptacek & David Adrian
items.desc: Freeform, deeply technical talk on cryptography, secure protocols, post-quantum and systems security.

items.name: CISO Tradecraft
items.desc: Structured, practical frameworks for security leadership: risk, governance, board communication and career growth.

items.name: Resilient Cyber
items.desc: Software supply chain, secure development, cloud and public-sector cyber policy, bridging engineering and leadership.

items.name: Cyber Security Sauna
items.desc: Relaxed, well-produced conversations with researchers and CISOs about threats, careers and offensive security ethics.

items.name: Risk Management Show
items.desc: GRC, business continuity, risk quantification and cyber insurance from a business perspective.

items.name: Women in the Middle (WiCyS)
items.desc: Mentorship, community building and career stories from leaders and emerging professionals.

items.name: Shift to AI
items.desc: Working CISOs on what agentic and AI-driven development means for security programmes and board conversations.

items.name: SANS Cyber Leaders Podcast
items.desc: Strategic, hype-free conversations between senior public- and private-sector security leaders.

items.name: The Security Detail
items.desc: Industry-by-industry look at the threat landscape, including coverage of NATO's Cyber Coalition exercise.

items.name: Microsoft Threat Intelligence Podcast
items.desc: Microsoft researchers on nation-state actors, malware, threat hunting and the stories behind investigations.

items.name: Click Here
items.desc: NPR-style reporting on cyber and intelligence stories with geopolitical stakes, in tight 30-minute episodes.

items.name: Latent Space
items.desc: AI engineering at depth: foundation models, agents, MCP and production architecture. Context for anyone securing AI systems.

items.name: Practical AI
items.desc: Grounded advice on deploying, scaling, securing and maintaining AI and ML in production.

items.name: The AI Daily Brief
items.desc: 15–20 minute daily analysis of the most significant AI developments.

items.name: The TWIML AI Podcast
items.desc: 900+ interviews with ML researchers and practitioners on models, deployment, fairness and enterprise adoption.

items.name: Industrial Security Podcast
items.desc: Interviews with OT and ICS practitioners on protecting industrial operations and critical infrastructure.

items.name: Unsolicited Response
items.desc: Opinionated discussion of ICS/OT security strategy, research and the industry from the founder of the S4 conference.

items.name: Critical Thinking – Bug Bounty Podcast
items.desc: Deeply technical weekly show on web hacking techniques, bug bounty methodology and recent findings.

items.name: Paul's Security Weekly
items.desc: Long-running technical show with news, interviews and tool talk across offensive and defensive security.

items.name: How to Measure Anything in Cybersecurity Risk
items.desc: Replaces risk heat maps with quantitative, probabilistic methods security leaders can defend to a board.

items.name: Supremacy: AI, ChatGPT and the Race That Will Change the World
items.desc: The race between OpenAI and DeepMind and what concentrated AI power means — useful context for AI security and governance.

items.name: Privacy Is Power
items.desc: A philosopher's case for why personal data is power and how individuals and societies can take it back.

items.name: The Ransomware Hunting Team
items.desc: The true story of volunteer researchers who crack ransomware strains and help victims recover for free.

items.name: Permanent Record
items.desc: Snowden's account of mass-surveillance programmes and his decision to disclose them.

items.name: Psychology of Intelligence Analysis
items.desc: Classic CIA text on cognitive bias and structured analytic techniques — essential for CTI analysts. Freely available from the CIA.

items.name: Humble Bundle eBook bundles
items.desc: Rotating, pay-what-you-want bundles that frequently include security titles from No Starch, Wiley, O'Reilly and Packt.

items.name: Security Engineering (3rd ed.)
items.desc: The definitive guide to building dependable distributed systems; much of the text is free online from the author.

items.name: Threat Modeling: Designing for Security
items.desc: Practical approach to finding design flaws early using STRIDE and related methods.

items.name: Sandworm
items.desc: Narrative of Russia's GRU hackers behind NotPetya and the Ukrainian grid attacks.

items.name: Countdown to Zero Day
items.desc: The definitive account of Stuxnet and the dawn of cyber-physical warfare.

items.name: The Cuckoo's Egg
items.desc: The original hacker hunt — an astronomer tracks a KGB-linked intruder through 1980s networks. Still a masterclass in investigation.

items.name: Intelligence-Driven Incident Response (2nd ed.)
items.desc: How to integrate threat intelligence into IR using the F3EAD cycle.

items.name: The Practice of Network Security Monitoring
items.desc: Foundational guide to collecting, analysing and escalating on network evidence.

items.name: Practical Malware Analysis
items.desc: Hands-on, lab-based introduction to static and dynamic malware analysis.

items.name: Practical Vulnerability Management
items.desc: Building a low-cost vulnerability management programme with open-source tools.

items.name: Not with a Bug, But with a Sticker
items.by: Ram Shankar Siva Kumar & Hyrum Anderson
items.desc: Accessible tour of adversarial machine learning and why AI systems are uniquely attackable.

items.name: Tribe of Hackers
items.desc: Career advice from 70 security practitioners, answering the same questions — great for newcomers.

items.name: Hacking Exposed Industrial Control Systems
items.desc: Attack-and-defend walkthrough of ICS/SCADA environments and their protocols.

items.name: This Is How They Tell Me the World Ends
items.desc: Investigation into the zero-day market and the cyber arms race.
